opening.argument: The footage shows a staged Rammstein concert performance: musicians play keyboards and drums before a large audience as pyrotechnic flames form part of the production. The title identifies the performance as live, and the description presents a DVD and Blu-ray package containing a documentary about the band, a short film about an album’s making, and the Madison Square Garden show. These are concert and entertainment materials offered as an ordinary product promotion. Nothing in the cited material establishes an investment, credential, payment, or deceptive-participation mechanism; nor does it establish any viewer loss or outcome beyond the promotion itself.

citations.quote: Rammstein - Engel (Live from Madison Square Garden)
a major new documentary about the band, Rammstein In Amerika; a short film about the making of their "Liebe Ist Für Alle Da" album; and the whole of their legendary Madison Square Garden show.
